mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys01_company WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm, sys01_loc_nm, sys01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{companyName})
AND ( (#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn, 'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false') )
ORDER BY sys01_company_id

SELECT sys01_company_id AS company_id, sys01_login_secure_yn AS login_secure_yn, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm, sys01_mail_info AS mail_info, sys01_emgrcy_passwd AS emgrcy_passwd, sys01_erp_product_cd AS erp_product_cd, f_cdnm('ErpProductCode', sys01_erp_product_cd, sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS erp_product_nm, sys01_cont_type AS cont_type, sys01_notice_date::date AS notice_date, sys01_close_date::date AS close_date, sys01_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_cd, sys01_icam_advis_company_cd AS icam_advis_company_cd, sys01_asset_yn AS asset_yn, sys01_advis_yn AS advis_yn, sys01_pbs_yn AS pbs_yn, sys01_use_yn AS use_yn, sys01_note AS note, sys01_biz_no AS biz_no FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT sys01_main_image_id FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys01_company SET sys01_main_image_id = #{mainImageId} WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

UPDATE sys01_company SET sys01_note = #{note} WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

INSERT INTO pay04_formula (pay04_formula_id, pay04_company_id, pay04_start_date, pay04_formula_cd, pay04_formula_form, pay04_rate, pay04_note) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, a.pay04_start_date, a.pay04_formula_cd, a.pay04_formula_form, a.pay04_rate, a.pay04_note FROM pay04_formula a INNER JOIN sys09_code b ON a.pay04_formula_cd = b.sys09_code AND sys09_company_id = pay04_company_id INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind c ON c.sys08_code_kind_id = b.sys09_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_sys_yn = 'false' AND pay04_company_id = 0 AND sys08_kind_cd = 'PayFormulaCode' AND pay04_start_date = ( SELECT max(d.pay04_start_date) FROM pay04_formula d WHERE d.pay04_company_id = 0 AND d.pay04_start_date <= f_sysdate() )
